opening.argument: The video presents an ordinary Crowdtap tutorial: viewers complete a profile, receive questions, missions, or polls, and accumulate points through survey-style activities. The tutorial explains that “these are my points I can redeem for gift cards, subscriptions or charities,” while describing entries such as shopping and household-product surveys with specified point amounts. It also shows that the activities can be completed through the mobile app or a tablet and reports, “i successfully got five points.” Nothing described requires payment, credentials, or investment, and the evidence does not establish a guaranteed financial return or claimed losses. The separate promotional context is disclosed as affiliate marketing, with “Some of the links above are affiliate links which I make a small percentage of sales through,” rather than presented as a deceptive Crowdtap mechanism.
